title: Dépistage nutritionnel périopératoire (PONS)
formula:
The PONS is positive if any of the following are present:

- [BMI](nabda:calc.body-mass-index-bmi-body-surface-area-bsa) <18.5 kg/m² (<20 kg/m² if age >65).
- Unplanned weight loss >10% in past 6 months.
- Have been eating <50% of normal diet in preceding week.
- Albumin <3.0 g/dL.

how_to_use.why:
- La malnutrition est un prédicteur indépendant de la morbidité et de la mortalité postopératoires et est associée à une augmentation de la durée de séjour et des taux de réadmission.
- Cet outil dépiste le risque de malnutrition, permettant une évaluation plus approfondie, une optimisation nutritionnelle périopératoire et une amélioration potentielle des résultats chirurgicaux.
how_to_use.when: À utiliser lors de la consultation préopératoire chez les patients adultes (≥ 18 ans) devant bénéficier d'une chirurgie majeure ou programmée.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed within the American Society for Enhanced Recovery (ASER)/Perioperative Quality Initiative (POQI) framework and modified from the [Malnutrition Universal Screening Tool](nabda:calc.malnutrition-universal-screening-tool-must) .
- Not diagnostic for malnutrition; this tool screens for nutrition risk.
- Does not risk-stratify surgical outcomes; performance for predicting overall postoperative complications is modest and varies by population.
- Although albumin is neither sensitive nor specific for malnutrition, it was included due to low cost, common use in perioperative testing, and strong associations with surgical risk and mortality.
- Inflammatory states can lower serum albumin; interpret with caution if albumin is the only criterion met.

next_steps.management:
For any **positive criteria** :

- The patient is considered at high nutrition risk.
- Refer the patient to a registered dietitian for a comprehensive assessment and a perioperative nutrition plan, such as:

 - Minimizing or avoiding preoperative fasting.
 - Early postoperative feeding, when appropriate.
 - Preoperative and postoperative supplementation, such as

 - High-protein oral nutrition supplements.
 - Enteral nutrition for patients unable to meet daily needs orally.
 - Parenteral nutrition if enteral nutrition does not meet nutritional goals.

For more detailed recommendations, please see the[ASER/POQI Joint Consensus Statement](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29369092/).

more_info:
Interpretation:

| PONS | Malnutrition Risk |
| --- | --- |
| Negative | Low |
| Positive | High |
